name: Russia–NATO
value: Poland border alert 2–8 Nov; no Article 4
summary: Poland ran a Kaliningrad border operation over sabotage warnings from 2 Nov; no Article 4 request or direct clash found
state: Polish security forces launched an operation on the Kaliningrad border on 2 Nov after warnings of planned sabotage, deploying counter-terrorism police (Kyiv Independent; Ukrainska Pravda). Poland said on 4 Nov it had thwarted a possible provocation near the border. No Article 4 request, direct clash or attack on NATO territory was found as of 11 Nov.
for_you: Follow national police and government guidance if travelling near NATO's eastern borders.
